text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 502/504 rate observed from edge gateway in eu-west-1. Alert threshold breached (p95 error rate > 1.5%). Paging oncall. thread created at 1909876543

anne: I'm on it. seeing a sharp jump starting ~1909876400, mostly 502 gateway responses. Latency also up for upstream calls.

raj: I got paged and pulling up dashboard now. Is this global or regional?

anne: Mostly eu-west-1, but small blips in us-west. Traffic to model-serving appears normal; errors are at the edge proxy layer.

max: looking at edge logs, a large fraction of 502s are `upstream reset` from internal gateway pool. Could be connection exhaustion.

tia: Any customer-facing impact? CX reports one enterprise noticing increased retries.

anne: Initial estimate: 5-8% of requests in eu-west failing with 502/504. For streaming sessions some dropped mid-stream.

raj: Ok. Triage plan: 1) verify edge proxy pool health 2) check connection counts and file descriptors 3) apply temporary throttling or route failover to other regions 4) notify support for customer comms.

max: Running `kubectl -n edge get pods -o wide` now. Seeing some edge-proxy pods in CrashLoopBackOff and several at 100% ephemeral ports used.

anne: Paste of recent tail from an edge proxy: ```
2026-03-14T15:22:01Z edge-proxy-7f6c4 ERROR upstream reset by peer: connection refused
2026-03-14T15:22:03Z edge-proxy-7f6c4 WARN exhausted ephemeral ports: 1023/1024
2026-03-14T15:22:05Z edge-proxy-7f6c4 ERROR exceeded max connections to backend
```

raj: That lines up with connection exhaustion. Two immediate mitigations: bump ephemeral port range and trigger a rolling restart of edge-proxy pool; also enable per-IP connection limits lower to stop a single client from saturating.

max: I can increase ephemeral ports on nodes, but that's a kernel change and will require node restart. We can also scale up edge-proxy replicas to absorb backlog.

anne: Scale up edge-proxy by +50% in eu-west now. Rolling restart after replica increase so new pods get clean state. Command: 
```
kubectl -n edge scale deployment/edge-proxy --replicas=12
```

max: Scaling now.

sre-bot: Deployment edge-proxy scaled to 12 replicas by max at 1909876602.

anne: Also applying per-route rate limit for a hot route that appears to be spiking: set `x-ratelimit` to 50r/s for /v1/generate in eu-west as temporary throttle.

max: Applying the rate limit via envoy config. Patch: ```
PATCH /configs/envoy/eu-west
- rate_limits: none
+ rate_limits: { "/v1/generate": 50 }
```

sre-bot: Envoy config patched by max at 1909876620.

oliver: Support: I let the affected customer (acme corp) know we're investigating; they see higher retry rates and will escalate if no update in 15m.

tia: Noted. I posted interim status to the incident Slack channel and emailed the account team.

anne: After scale and rate-limit we see error rate drop from 6.1% -> 1.2% in eu-west. Latency trending down. Keep monitoring for 15 minutes.

raj: Good. Are any edge pods still OOM/crashloop?

max: One pod still restarting due to ephemeral port exhaustion on node-3. I recommended cordoning node-3 and draining.

anne: Go ahead and cordon, drain, then reprovision node-3 (should be autoscaled). Command: `kubectl cordon node-3 && kubectl drain node-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`

max: Node cordoned and draining started.

sre-bot: node-3 cordoned by max at 1909876689.

anne: Action items while we stabilize: - keep rate limit in place for 30m - follow up with infra to adjust ephemeral port range and kernel tuning - add health-check and backpressure to upstream to avoid hard resets - prepare customer postmortem note if we reach >1hr impact

raj: I'll take on kernel tuning ticket and sync with infra tomorrow.

max: After drain, new pods are healthy and no crashes observed. Error rate in eu-west now at 0.4%. Rolling restart not needed.

anne: Thanks. I'm going to mark this as mitigated for now. Keeping thread open for follow-up and post-incident action items.

oliver: Customer updated with mitigation and ETA for root cause analysis. They said :thumbsup: but want RCA and timeline.

tia: I'll create a support ticket linking this thread and the metrics graphs.

sre-bot: Incident state changed to MITIGATED by anne at 1909876900.

anne: Handoff to next oncall (raj) for postmortem and infra action items. Raj, you got the ticket?

raj: Yep taking the postmortem. I'll include kernel tunables, autoscaler thresholds, and an action to add circuit-breaker for edge-backend connections. ETA for draft RCA: EOD tomorrow.

max: Notes for the RCA: root cause = ephemeral port/socket exhaustion on a small subset of nodes triggered by a traffic spike from a customer job + lack of connection backpressure between edge and backend. Mitigation = scale + rate-limit + node reprovision. Long term = kernel tuning + circuit breaker + per-customer rate ceilings.

anne: Closing thread after 30m if no regressions. Great job everyone. :tada:
